opus.problem: Gives the word away. 'Its queen came to test Solomon with difficult questions' is the best-known description of the queen of Sheba, so this clue alone names the answer and is not medium hard.

Not quite true to the verse. In Isaiah 60:6 the camels belong to Midian and Ephah. Those from Sheba are only said to come bearing gold and frankincense and praising the LORD, so tying the camels to this land misreads the verse.
